about.title: About us
about.intro: Booklia was born from a simple idea: making service exchanges between individuals easier in a trusted environment. We believe everyone has valuable skills to share.

mission.title: Connecting local talent
mission.description1: We created Booklia to meet a simple need: helping everyone easily find help for their everyday projects, while offering local talent a platform to showcase their skills.
mission.description2: Our unique reputation system, based on experience and trust, ensures smooth exchanges and encourages excellence.

values.title: Our values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide our every action
values.trustDesc: Our reputation system ensures transparent and secure exchanges between all members.
values.communityDesc: We believe in the power of the collective and encourage authentic human connections.
values.kindnessDesc: Every interaction is an opportunity for mutual help and sharing skills.
values.simplicityDesc: An intuitive platform where finding or offering a service takes just a few clicks.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Booklia was born from a simple observation: in our daily lives, we often need help with various tasks - from DIY to tutoring, from gardening to tech support. And around us, talented people would be happy to offer their services.
story.p2: We wanted to create a space where these connections happen naturally, in a trusted environment. Our innovative reputation system, inspired by video game progression mechanics, makes the experience engaging while ensuring the quality of exchanges.
story.p3: Today, Booklia grows thanks to you, our community. Every service exchanged strengthens our conviction: together, we can create a more human and supportive local economy.
